reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message. The ticket is **#88412**: the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging freezing on the BOL barcode scan.

I found it in #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. Tobias posted it there on 2 Jul 2025 and then made clear he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed. There are no account files for Tansleigh in the shared files, so that #central-team message is the only record I could find.
